SELECT agent_id, name, city, vehicle_type, tier,
       avg_rating, total_deliveries, join_date
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_agents_cleaned"

SELECT complaint_id, order_id, customer_id, complaint_category,
       complaint_subcategory, description, resolution_time_hrs,
       compensation_amount, complaint_ts, is_resolved
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_complaints_cleaned"

SELECT customer_id, name, city, signup_date, loyalty_tier, total_orders
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_customers_cleaned"

SELECT restaurant_id, name, city, zone, cuisine_type,
       avg_rating, avg_prep_time_mins, tier,
       join_date, is_active, commission_pct
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_restaurants_cleaned"

SELECT order_id, customer_id, restaurant_id, agent_id,
       order_ts, delivery_ts, status,
       total_amount, discount_amount,
       city, zone, cuisine_type, delivery_time_mins
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_orders_cleaned"

SELECT payment_id, order_id, amount, payment_method,
       gateway, status, payment_ts, cashback
FROM "airflow"."public"."silver_payments_cleaned"

SELECT
    complaint_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    complaint_category,
    complaint_subcategory,
    description,
    resolution_time_hrs,
    compensation_amount,
    complaint_ts,
    is_resolved
FROM "airflow"."gold_silver"."stg_complaints"

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY source_table, error_reason) AS report_id,
    source_table,
    error_reason,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrence_count
FROM (
    SELECT source_table, error_reason FROM "airflow"."public"."stg_rejected_level1"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT source_table, error_reason FROM "airflow"."public"."stg_rejected_level2"
) x
GROUP BY source_table, error_reason

SELECT
    payment_id,
    order_id,
    amount,
    cashback,
    payment_method,
    gateway,
    status,
    payment_ts,
    (status = 'success') AS is_successful
FROM "airflow"."gold_silver"."stg_payments"

WITH orders AS (
    SELECT * FROM "airflow"."gold_silver"."stg_orders"
),
restaurants_with_sk AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY restaurant_id, dbt_valid_from) AS restaurant_sk,
        restaurant_id,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_from, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_from,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_to, '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_to
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."dim_restaurant"
),
customers_with_sk AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_id, dbt_valid_from) AS customer_sk,
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_from, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_from,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_to, '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_to
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."dim_customer"
),
agents_with_sk AS (
    SELECT
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agent_id, dbt_valid_from) AS agent_sk,
        agent_id,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_from, '1900-01-01'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_from,
        COALESCE(dbt_valid_to, '9999-12-31'::timestamp) AS dbt_valid_to
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."dim_agent"
)
SELECT
    o.order_id,
    r.restaurant_sk,
    c.customer_sk,
    a.agent_sk,
    o.order_ts,
    o.status,
    o.total_amount,
    o.discount_amount,
    (o.total_amount - COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0)) AS net_amount,
    o.delivery_time_mins,
    o.city,
    o.zone,
    o.cuisine_type,
    (o.delivery_time_mins > 45) AS is_late,
    (o.status = 'cancelled') AS cancellation_flag
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN restaurants_with_sk r
    ON r.restaurant_id = o.restaurant_id
   AND o.order_ts >= r.dbt_valid_from
   AND o.order_ts < r.dbt_valid_to
LEFT JOIN customers_with_sk c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
   AND o.order_ts >= c.dbt_valid_from
   AND o.order_ts < c.dbt_valid_to
LEFT JOIN agents_with_sk a
    ON a.agent_id = o.agent_id
   AND o.order_ts >= a.dbt_valid_from
   AND o.order_ts < a.dbt_valid_to

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT
        agent_sk,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', order_ts)::date AS week_start_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_late) AS on_time_deliveries,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cancellation_flag) AS cancelled_deliveries
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."fact_orders"
    WHERE agent_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY week_start_date, agent_sk) AS report_id,
    agent_sk,
    week_start_date,
    total_deliveries,
    on_time_deliveries,
    ROUND(on_time_deliveries::numeric / NULLIF(total_deliveries, 0) * 100, 2) AS on_time_pct,
    cancelled_deliveries,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY week_start_date ORDER BY total_deliveries DESC) AS rank
FROM weekly

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        customer_sk,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', order_ts)::date AS month,
        COUNT(*) AS orders_in_month
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."fact_orders"
    WHERE cancellation_flag = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY month) AS report_id,
    month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_in_month > 1) AS repeat_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_in_month = 1) AS one_time_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_in_month >= 5) AS frequent_customers,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_in_month > 1)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS repeat_rate_pct
FROM monthly
GROUP BY month

WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT
        restaurant_sk,
        DATE_TRUNC('week', order_ts)::date AS week_start_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'delivered') AS completed_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS cancelled_orders,
        SUM(net_amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM "airflow"."gold"."fact_orders"
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY week_start_date, restaurant_sk) AS report_id,
    restaurant_sk,
    week_start_date,
    total_orders,
    completed_orders,
    cancelled_orders,
    total_revenue,
    ROUND(cancelled_orders::numeric / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) * 100, 2) AS cancellation_rate,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY week_start_date ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank
FROM weekly

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('day', order_ts), city) AS report_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('day', order_ts)::date AS report_date,
    city,
    cuisine_type,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(total_amount) AS gross_revenue,
    SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_given,
    SUM(net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM "airflow"."gold"."fact_orders"
GROUP BY 1 = 1, DATE_TRUNC('day', order_ts), city, cuisine_type
